closure.occurrences: profile occurrence count equals the composition logical-occurrence count
closure.claims: profile claim count equals the testimony count
closure.profile_binding: every testimony is bound to the admitted source profile
closure.recipe_binding: every testimony is bound to the admitted recipe receipt
closure.lineage_binding: every testimony names a durably present evidence-lineage node
closure.subjects: closed subject count equals the source-profile closure subject count
closure.readback: one nonzero fingerprint binds the declared reconstruction and reference-reachability readback
closure.observation: zero-claim content retains profile, composition, exact readback and closed subjects; absent evidence references and zero counts are committed by the native identity and receipt, with no fabricated testimony

batch_rule: strictly increasing admission identity under one exact selected boundary

conditional_component_receipts.evidence-lineage: required for nonzero profile claims; absent only with testimony and all evidence counts zero
conditional_component_receipts.evidence-testimony: required for nonzero profile claims; absent only with lineage and all evidence counts zero
